IMPACT 8/10
Renault Builds EV Motors With Zero Rare Earths
Renault Group has pioneered electric motors using wound-rotor synchronous technology,
eliminating the need for rare earth minerals like neodymium that dominate
conventional EV motor designs. The innovation severs EV manufacturing's strategic
• Copper wound-rotor design replaces neodymium permanent magnets entirely
• Renault is first major automaker to deploy rare-earth-free motors at production
scale
• China controls over 85% of global rare earth processing, making this a major
supply chain shift

IMPACT 7/10
Arch Linux Malware Hits Over 1,500 Packages
A major supply chain attack compromised more than 1,500 packages in the Arch Linux
AUR community repository, one of the largest such incidents in Linux distribution
history. The Arch team states the malware incident is now under control.
• More than 1,500 AUR packages confirmed compromised in the attack
• AUR serves millions of Arch Linux users worldwide as the primary community repo
• Arch Linux team declared the incident under control after emergency response
